name: Extra Modifying Word
body:
Prerequisite(s) Modifying Word class feature

Benefit(s): You gain one additional modifying word. You must meet all of the prerequisites for this modifying word.

Special: You can gain Extra Modifying Word multiple times, but at most once per 5 Speaker levels.

Speaker: A Pathfinder 1e class designed for use in the Lost Lands, © 2021, Michael Mars, Author Michael Mars Russell
